text:
lena: Quick Q — should saved queries capture where they were created? Right now it's opaque and it's making per-route cost + ownership fuzzy.

rishi: yes please. We lose signal when folks copy/paste queries between routes. Even a tiny origin tag would help analytics joins.

tom: Implementation thought: add saved_query.origin (string) and saved_query.origin_meta (string) optional. origin could be a compact token like 'route:r-44|model:rook-3b|view:compare'. origin_meta only for console (free form, e.g. last_pin=variant-2). Keep origin_meta nullable.

priyanka: UX: show small pill under saved query title: "Created on <route name> • <model>". If origin missing show "Created via console". Avoid adding columns.

lena: Sampling: console preview uses sampling so saved_query.preview_cost isn't reliable. We should record a snapshot of the preview_estimate at save time (tokens_estimate) and emit event to telemetry.

rishi: API: don't bloat the primary saved query GET response. Make origin an optional top-level field but only populate when present. Add /saved_queries?include_origin=true for consumers that need it.

tom: For cost estimates we can reuse route telemetry: GET /routes/:id/estimate?model=... returns {"p50_tokens": "1200", "p95_tokens": "3500"}. Frontend picks p50 for preview. Keep endpoint read-only and cacheable.

priyanka: Rollout plan: behind feature-flag. Phase 1: store origin but no UI. Phase 2: show pill + telemetry for 10% orgs. Phase 3: make pill default and surface copy provenance.

lena: Copy semantics: when user "Save as" into a different route we should preserve original origin but also add last_copied_to field. UI shows "Copied to <route> on <date>". That preserves lineage.

rishi: Telemetry schema: saved_query.snapshot should include origin, route_id (nullable), model, tokens_estimate, and feature_flag_version. We'll emit a console_event on save and on preview run.

tom: DB change: add column origin_text TEXT NULL, tokens_estimate INT NULL, preview_snapshot JSONB NULL. Prefer minimal for migration; keep snapshot optional. Add index on (route_id) since we'll query by route.

priyanka: Security: origin_text can contain route names which may be org-specific. No PII expected but keep it in org-scoped table and make sure export scrubs route internal IDs unless authorized.

infra-bot: infra: migration queued (PR #4821). Feature flag gates added. Staging migration scheduled at 03:00 UTC.

lena: One subtlety: saved queries created from global "all routes" search — origin should be "global" or empty? I vote for explicit 'global' so telemetry counts separate.

rishi: Agreed. Also add a tiny enum for origin_source: [route, model_page, global, unknown, import] — store as a short string.

tom: I'll prototype the API contract and sample responses today. Example GET /saved_queries/987 -> { id:987, query: '...', origin: 'route:r-44|model:rook-3b', origin_source: 'route', tokens_estimate: 1200 }

priyanka: Frontend: when saving from route view attach origin payload. When saving from query editor default origin_source to 'global' unless user was on a route. Also show hover tooltip with "saved from: <route name> — last pinned: <variant>".

lena: OK let's keep scope small: feature-flag, DB column, optional API field, telemetry snapshot on save. We can iterate on preview endpoint and extra estimates after initial canary.

infra-bot: canary rollout scheduled: 10% orgs next Tue. CI build link: https://ci.internal/4821 :white_check_mark:

rishi: Great. I'll add docs for the event and the new API flag. CC @billing for quota preview hook.

priyanka: ping me if the UI needs a new CSS token for the pill (tiny design).

lena: thanks team — i'll capture tasks and mark ownership. Follow-up if anyone hits blockers.
